items.title: OpenAI发布GPT-5.6系列模型，旗舰模型Sol正式开放使用
items.raw_excerpt: 当地时间7月9日，OpenAI宣布，GPT-5.6系列模型正式全面开放，包括旗舰模型GPT-5.6 Sol、均衡型模型Terra和低成本模型Luna。其中，Sol支持全新的Ultra模式，可默认协调4个AI代理并行处理复杂任务，进一步提升代码开发、科研、网络安全及知识工作等场景的效率。OpenAI称，GPT-5.6系列在多项基准测试中实现业内领先，并在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低推理成本和响应时间。公司同时表示，GPT-5.6配备迄今最完善的安全防护体系，并正式支持程序化工具调用，进一步增强复杂任务自动执行能力。（界面）

title_i18n.zh: OpenAI发布GPT-5.6系列模型，旗舰模型Sol正式开放使用
title_i18n.en: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6 series models, flagship model Sol officially available for use.
title_i18n.es: OpenAI lanza la serie de modelos GPT-5.6, el modelo insignia Sol se abre oficialmente para su uso.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 当地时间7月9日，OpenAI宣布，GPT-5.6系列模型正式全面开放，包括旗舰模型GPT-5.6 Sol、均衡型模型Terra和低成本模型Luna。其中，Sol支持全新的Ultra模式，可默认协调4个AI代理并行处理复杂任务，进一步提升代码开发、科研、网络安全及知识工作等场景的效率。OpenAI称，GPT-5.6系列在多项基准测试中实现业内领先，并在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低推理成本和响应时间。公司同时表示，GPT-5.6配备迄今最完善的安全防护体系，并正式支持程序化工具调用，进一步增强复杂任务自动执行能力。（界面）
excerpt_i18n.en: On July 9, local time, OpenAI announced the full release of the GPT-5.6 series of models, including the flagship model GPT-5.6 Sol, the balanced model Terra, and the low-cost model Luna. Among them, Sol supports a new Ultra mode, which can default to coordinating four AI agents to process complex tasks in parallel, further improving efficiency in scenarios such as code development, scientific research, cybersecurity, and knowledge work. OpenAI stated that the GPT-5.6 series achieves industry-leading performance on multiple benchmark tests, while significantly reducing inference costs and response times while maintaining or improving performance. The company also noted that GPT-5.6 is equipped with the most comprehensive safety protection system to date and officially supports programmatic tool calls, further enhancing the ability to automate complex tasks. (Jiemian)
excerpt_i18n.es: El 9 de julio, hora local, OpenAI anunció la disponibilidad general de la serie de modelos GPT-5.6, incluidos el modelo insignia GPT-5.6 Sol, el modelo equilibrado Terra y el modelo de bajo coste Luna. Entre ellos, Sol es compatible con el nuevo modo Ultra, que puede coordinar por defecto 4 agentes de IA para procesar tareas complejas en paralelo, mejorando aún más la eficiencia en escenarios como desarrollo de código, investigación científica, ciberseguridad y trabajo de conocimiento. OpenAI afirmó que la serie GPT-5.6 logra un liderazgo en la industria en múltiples pruebas de referencia, y reduce significativamente el coste de inferencia y el tiempo de respuesta mientras mantiene o mejora el rendimiento. items.title: Up the Stack: How AI's Escape from the Commodity Trap Risks Enterprise Lock-In
items.raw_excerpt: Our goal in this essay is to move beyond the debate over whether AI is a bubble. We do so in two ways: clearly separating current financials from the question of who captures value in the long run, and recognizing that the labs are not confined to be model providers. They can migrate up the stack and are already aggressively doing so. This will likely allow them to escape the commodity trap but raises new concerns — customer lock-in and reduced competition.
